<thought>First, create a list of diverse sulphide compositions (≤ 40). Then retrieve polymorphs for all of them in batch mode with the required filters (max_energy_above_hull = 0.3 eV/atom, max_per_composition = 3) and store the files in a directory. Afterwards, list the generated files, build a mapping from composition to its JSON file, and consolidate them into a single dataset. Finally, return the path to the consolidated JSON file.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "FeS", "FeS2", "CuS", "Cu2S", "ZnS", "PbS", "SnS", "SnS2",
        "MoS2", "WS2", "NiS", "NiS2", "CoS", "CoS2", "MnS", "MnS2",
        "TiS2", "V2S3", "Ag2S", "Au2S", "CdS", "CdS2", "GaS", "InS",
        "Sb2S3", "Bi2S3", "GeS", "GeS2", "Al2S3", "SiS2", "B2S3",
        "CrS", "CrS2", "ZrS2", "HfS2", "NbS2", "TaS2", "ReS2", "OsS2"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "sulphide_polymorphs"
}</action_input>
